## Customer Merge Implementation Complete

**✅ 21 new tests passing** (341 total tests, 333 pass, 8 pre-existing render failures)

### New Function in src/customers.js:

**mergeCustomers(customers, invoices, fromId, intoId)**
- Merges a duplicate customer into another customer
- Returns ok({ customers, invoices })
- customers: array with fromId customer removed
- invoices: array with all fromId invoices reassigned to intoId
- Normalizes IDs (trim, uppercase) for comparison
- Immutable operations (no input mutation)
- Errors:
  - SAME_CUSTOMER if fromId === intoId (case-insensitive)
  - CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND if either customer doesn't exist
